digest.component_or_area: CI scheduling / reconciler bridge and canary workflows
propositions: Bridge cron backstop cadence must change from */20 minutes to uniform 40-minute intervals (expressed as three cron entries over a 2-hour cycle: 0 0-23/2 * * *, 40 0-23/2 * * *, 20 1-23/2 * * *) to halve CI runner pool footprint

Opt-in continuous reconciler chain must sleep for the pass's own elapsed duration before re-dispatching (capped at 900s, skipped above 1800s elapsed, guarded when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is unset) to double the inter-invocation period without adding a new repo Variable
Canary job schedule must change from hourly (0 * * * *) to 2-hourly (0 */2 * * *) to reduce dispatch frequency
Canary staleness alert window must increase from 2 hours to 4 hours (ALERT_WINDOW_HOURS env and input defaults) to maintain 3x cadence margin at the new 40-minute floor
Consecutive cron fire-time gaps must be asserted uniformly at 40 minutes in tests to validate the three-entry spelling property

All documentation and comments referencing */20 cadence or hourly canary must be updated for truthfulness, with worst-case reconcile latency (20→40 min) and canary detection latency (1h→2h poll, 2h→4h window) recorded alongside the cadence table
